Subject: Roadmap deconflict: exec asks & exceptions ahead of June GA

Team — following this morning's cross-functional sync I wanted to capture the open items that came up from exec and the Stratus pre-GA conversation. Please review and call out ownership/timing by EOD Monday. I linked the exception spreadsheet and MAP in the attachments.

Summary of asks from exec / customer:
- Exec asks: two hard asks from CIO (Stratus) — (1) add a per-tenant retention override control for PII logs; (2) guaranteed 120ms p95 for the default 2k token path for dedicated customers (June GA target).
- Roadmap exceptions: current plan pushes the retention toggle to Q3 and the p95 perf target depends on quantization/kernel changes that are currently under test.

Immediate asks (owners):
1) Retention override: Lauren — confirm compliance review and proposed approval path; need language for SLA addendum.
2) Perf p95: Karthik — feasibility check and two-sprint mitigation plan (fallback routing + tighter batching) so we can present to exec on 6/4.
3) Customer comms / MAP: Marissa — update MAP with proposed milestones and escalate DocuSign path if necessary.

Attachments: roadmap-exceptions-2027-05-28.pdf (summary of exceptions), mutual-action-plan-STRATUS-20270528.xlsx

Notes: Sara/Isaac — appreciate visibility; we'll confirm whether this requires a special SLA amendment or a dedicated offer. Connor
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Roadmap deconflict: exec asks & exceptions ahead of June GA

Thanks Connor — quick responses inline.

> 1) Retention override: Lauren — confirm compliance review and proposed approval path; need language for SLA addendum.

I spoke with Legal & Privacy this morning. High-level:
- Compliance OK with per-tenant retention override as long as it is gated by a signed attestation and uses KMS-wrapped keys for exported logs.
- Legal wants SLA language limited to "retention override available upon agreement and attestation"; they will not commit to a hard-duration SLA without an exception review.

Next steps (ownership):
- I'll draft proposed SLA addendum language by 2027-06-01 17:00 PT and circulate to Legal.
- If exec insists on a hard SLA we need an exception form routed to Security & COO for sign-off (timeline ~2 business days post-submission).

Marissa: can you slot the addendum draft into the MAP so Stratus can review concurrently?

-Lauren

Quick feasibility note and suggested mitigation plan.

Feasibility:
- The 120ms p95 on 2k tokens for dedicated customers is tight for current quantized weights on A100-class hosts with the default kernel. With the current model variant it's ~150-180ms p95 in our benchmark.

Mitigations we can execute over two sprints (2 weeks):
A) Short-term (Sprint 1 - 1 week):
  - Implement request-level tighter batching policy for the Stratus route (reduce batching window from 12ms -> 6ms). Estimated perf delta: ~8-12% improvement.
  - Route VIP requests to a larger instance config (burst GPU) for the p95 tail. Ops already has a reserve we can use for two weeks.
B) Mid-term (Sprint 2 - 1 week):
  - Apply targeted kernel micro-optimizations for transformer attention (INF-2042). Estimated further ~10-15% improvement.

If combined, these get us into the ~115-125ms band in controlled tests; still need canary on production traffic to validate.

Action: I'll deliver a short runbook + perf notes by 2027-06-02 EOD and work with Ops to reserve burst capacity for the week of 6/7.

- Karthik
